name: Many-Worlds Interpretation
one_line: The Many-Worlds Interpretation (MWI) posits that the universal wave function is objectively real and there is no wave function collapse.

math_relation_to_SQM.equations_summary: MWI claims to be SQM taken literally, without the ad-hoc collapse postulate. It uses the same mathematical machinery but provides a different ontological story.

key_claims: The entire universe is described by a single, all-encompassing wave function Ψ_U which is objectively real.
The universal wave function evolves deterministically at all times according to the Schrödinger equation. There is no separate, non-unitary collapse process.
